Decklist: http://tappedout.net/mtg-decks/23-04-15-hqf-naya-burn/

Let me preface this by pointing out that it was my 2nd event using this deck. I played it a lot with friends, but it was always against the same old decks so my experience was limited mostly to the vacuum of my playgroup. Now with that said, on to the report.

Round 1 - Grixis Delver

Game 1

I had to mulligan for this game, my opener had no lands.

We were both able to take each other down to 2 life but at some point I drew 3 lands in a row and I wasn't able to catch up to his Gurmag Angler. Then I drew a Deflecting Palm. Passed the turn, he attacks with the angler with one card in his hand. I Deflecting Palm the Angler, he casts Snapcaster Mage, gets a lightning bolt and finish me with it.

Out: 2 Lavamancer, 2 Atarka's Command. In: 2 Path to Exile, 2 Rest in Peace.

Game 2

My opponent sided in a lot of counterspells and unfortunately I never drew any of my Rest in Peace, otherwise he would have been hosed by this card. Still, I was able to get him to 3 life and tried to Atarka's Commad him but got blasted by a Lightning Bolt again.

Notes: I have to give credit to my opponent, the second he saw I was playing burn, he very rarely fetched lands and never played shock lands untapped. It made a big difference I think.

Round 2 - UW Tron

Game 1

It basically was a race that I was lucky enough to win. Luckily for me, Goblin Guide almost never made him draw lands which I think helped a lot.

Out: 2 Goblin Guide, 2 Grim Lavamancer. In: 2 Molten Rain, 2 Path to Exile.

Game 2

My opponent opened up with a Leyline of Sanctity. Yikes. I should have seen that one coming. In my opening hand though I had a swiftspear and 2 eidolon. Played the swiftspear, played the eidolon and after that I kept burning myself to trigger the swiftspear's prowess ability and, to mine and my opponent's surprise, it worked.

Notes: Someone is playing white and it isn't a zoo build? Expect a Leyline of Sanctity.

Round 3 - Naya Zoo

Game 1

My opponent was able to have 2 Tarmogoyfs by turn 3. I tried to burn him out and for a minute there I was almost able to get there, but then at the end of my turn he casts collected company and drops 2 more Goyfs. Ouch.

Out: 2 Grim Lavamancer, 2 Atarka's Command. In: 2 Path to Exile, 2 Rest in peace.

Game 2

I start the game with a swiftspear, then turn 2 play an eidolon, and then turn 3 after he dropped a scavenging ooze and a goyf, dropped a rest in peace and he was hosed. He was able to get rid of my first eidolon and I used that opportunity to lightning helix him and then play an extra eidolon and that sealed the game.

Game 3

That game pretty much played exactly like the second one except that when I started picking up steam he dropped a kor firewalker and played a total of 3 collected company (one every turn) creating blockers against my creatures. After a while I got unlucky and drew lands 4 times in a row. At that point I was out of steam and couldn't keep up.

Notes: I hate Tarmogoyf.

Round 4 Amulet

Game 1

It was basically a race and I got lucky since he never drew an amulet.

Out: 4 goblin guide. In: 4 destructive revelry.

Game 2

It was a race again and even though my opponent played an amulet on turn 1 he got mana screwed so I was just free to burn him and attack with my creatures.

Notes: Removing the Goblin Guides was a good call in this match-up. The last thing I want to do is give my opponent lands.

Round 5

My opponent probably dropped and didn't bother checking it on his slip. So instead I played a friendly standard game with the guy who piloted the amulet deck I played against earlier. I hadn't updated my UW heroics deck since after KTK came out so, needles to say, I got my ass handed over to myself but I had fun nonetheless.

Final notes: Deflecting Palm and Rest in Peace (when I drew it) were both troopers and total hosers for my opponents. I really wish that Tron player had cast his Emrakul. I would have loved to Palm that sucker! In the end, I finished 3-2 but it's actually a 2-2 in my opinion, which considering I had never played against 3 of the 4 decks I faced, isn't too bad in my opinion. Really wish I had a Pyroclasm or Anger of the Gods during that Naya Zoo match-up. The guy's board was filled with 0/1 Goyfs and 2/2 Scoozes. I'm just not sure what to remove from my list to make room for it.

P-S: Forgive my bad english, it's not my first language.
